# Avatar bargaining analysis

## Load libraries

```{r}

set.seed(72529)

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(fixest)        # Fixed effects regression
library(survival)      # Cox regression
library(coxme)         # Cox regression with random effects
library(lavaan)        # SEM
library(modelsummary)
library(tinytable)
library(pbmcapply)     # Parallel
library(mnormt)        # Multivariate normal draw
library(ivreg2r)       # robust GMM/2SLS
```

```{r}

RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
masterSeed <- 779

parallelSupported <- TRUE
availableCores <- 15
M <- 100   # Multiple imputation draws
```

## Load data

```{r}

dataAvatarLong <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataAvatarLong.rds") %>%
  mutate(
    avatarDemand = avatarDemand / 1000,
    playerID = paste0(session, player, round)
  )

dataAvatarLong <- dataAvatarLong %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS(file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarLongSmiles.rds"),
    by = c("session", "player", "round", "startTime", "endTime", "agreement")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS(file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarLongDTW.rds"),
    by = c("playerID", "startTime", "endTime", "agreement")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS(file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarSmiles.rds"),
    by = c("session", "player", "round")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    roundTime10s = roundTime/10,
    avatarSmilePre  = avatarSmilePre * 10,
    avatarSmilePost = avatarSmilePost * 10,
    playerSmilePre  = playerSmilePre * 10,
    playerSmilePost = playerSmilePost * 10,
    across(
      starts_with("shape") | starts_with("deriv"),
      \(x) as.numeric(-scale(x)),
      .names = "sync{paste0(toupper(substr(.col, 1, 1)), substring(.col, 2))}"
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("shape") | starts_with("deriv"),
      \(x) -log(x),
      .names = "logSync{paste0(toupper(substr(.col, 1, 1)), substring(.col, 2))}"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS(file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarDTW.rds") %>%
      mutate(
        across(
          starts_with("shape") | starts_with("deriv"),
          \(x) as.numeric(-scale(x)),
          .names = "sync{paste0(toupper(substr(.col, 1, 1)), substring(.col, 2))}"
        ),
        across(
          starts_with("shape") | starts_with("deriv"),
          \(x) -log(x),
          .names = "logSync{paste0(toupper(substr(.col, 1, 1)), substring(.col, 2))}"
        )
      )
    , by = c("playerID")
  ) %>%
  group_by(clusterID) %>%
  mutate(
    stratumEventTime = ifelse(
      max(agreement)==1, # At least one round of the match ended in agreement
      min(roundTime),    # Time of the first event in the risk set (match)
      NA
    ),
    eventRound = ifelse(
      !is.na(stratumEventTime),
      as.numeric(roundTime == stratumEventTime),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dataAvatar <- dataAvatarLong %>%
  group_by(clusterID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    startTime < stratumEventTime & stratumEventTime <= endTime
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
  
dataSIS <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  readRDS("../Datasets/dataAvatar.rds"),
  readRDS("../Datasets/dataF2F.rds")
) %>%
  select(
    session, player, match, round, clusterID, starts_with("SIS")
  )

dataWideSIS <- dataSIS %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(session, player),
    names_from = round,
    values_from = starts_with("SIS"),
    names_glue = "R{round}_{.value}"
  )

dataConstants <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataConstants.rds")
```

## CFA

### SIS

#### State-trait model

```{r}

rounds <- 3:10

mappingSIS <- list(
  MD = c("SIS_MD1", "SIS_MD2"),
  C  = c("SIS_C1", "SIS_C2"),
  IC = c("SIS_IC1", "SIS_IC2"),
  P  = c("SIS_P1", "SIS_P2"),
  FD = c("SIS_FD1", "SIS_FD2")
)

stateSyntax <- paste(
  unlist(
    lapply(
      seq_along(mappingSIS),
      function(i) {
        sapply(
          rounds, 
          function(r){
            lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
            paste0(
              lvName, r, " =~ ", 
              paste(
                paste0(
                  paste0(lvName, "_L", seq_along(mappingSIS[[i]]), "*"),
                  paste0("R", r, "_", mappingSIS[[i]])
                ),
                collapse = " + "
              ),
              " \n "
            )
          }
        )
      }
    )
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

traitSyntax <- paste(
  sapply(
    seq_along(mappingSIS),
    function(i) {
      paste0(
        names(mappingSIS)[i], "_T =~ ",
        paste(
          paste0("1*", names(mappingSIS)[i], rounds),
          collapse = " + "
        ),
        " \n "
      )
    }
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

varianceSyntax <- paste(
  unlist(
    lapply(
      seq_along(mappingSIS),
      function(i) {
        lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
        stateVars <- sapply(
          rounds,
          function(r) {
            paste0(
              lvName, r, " ~~ ", lvName, "_V", r, "*", lvName, r, " \n "
            )
          }
        )
        traitVar <- paste0(lvName, "_T ~~ ", lvName, "_T_V*", lvName, "_T", " \n ")
#        traitVar <- paste0(lvName, "_T ~~ 1*", lvName, "_T", " \n ")
        
        c(stateVars, traitVar)
      }
    )
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

covarianceSyntax <- paste(
  unlist(
    sapply(
      seq_along(mappingSIS),
      function(i) {
        sapply(
          rounds[-length(rounds)],
          function(r) {
            lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
            
            rLeft <- (r+1):max(rounds)
            
            paste0(lvName, r, " ~~ ", paste(paste0("0*", lvName, rLeft), collapse= " + "), " \n ")
          }
        )
      }
    )
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

meanSyntax <- paste(
  unlist(
    sapply(
      seq_along(mappingSIS),
      function(i) {
        sapply(
          rounds,
          function(r) {
            lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
            paste0(lvName, r, " ~ ", lvName, "_M", r, "*1" ," \n ")
          }
        )
      }
    )
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

interceptSyntax <- paste(
  unlist(
    lapply(
      seq_along(mappingSIS),
      function(i) {
        lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
        unlist(
          lapply(
            seq_along(mappingSIS[[i]]),
            function(j) {
              paste0("R", rounds, "_", mappingSIS[[i]][[j]], " ~ ", lvName, j, "_I*1 \n ")
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  ),
  collapse = ""
)



identificationConstraints <- paste(
  sapply(
    seq_along(mappingSIS),
    function(i) {
      lvName <- names(mappingSIS)[i]
      stateMeans <- paste0(lvName, "_M", rounds)
      stateVariances <- paste0(lvName, "_V", rounds)
      
      paste0(
        # Pooled mean zero
        paste(stateMeans, collapse = " + "),
        " == 0 \n ",
        
        # Pooled variance one
        lvName, "_T_V + (",
        "(",
        paste(
          c(
            stateVariances,
            paste0("(", stateMeans, ")^2")
          ),
          collapse = " + "
        ),
        ") / ", length(rounds), " == 1 \n "
      )
    }
  ),
  collapse = ""
)


syntaxST <- paste(
  stateSyntax,
  traitSyntax,
  varianceSyntax,
  covarianceSyntax,
  meanSyntax,
  interceptSyntax,
  identificationConstraints
)
```


```{r}

stateFit <- cfa(
  syntaxS, 
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  std.lv = FALSE,
  auto.fix.first = FALSE,
#  missing = "fiml",
  verbose = TRUE,
  dataWideSIS
)

summary(stateFit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)
```

#### Pooled

```{r}

cfaModelSIS <- '

  mutualDependence =~ SIS_MD1 + SIS_MD2

  conflict =~ SIS_C1 + SIS_C2
  
  informationCertainty =~ SIS_IC1 + SIS_IC2
  
'

pooledFitSIS <- cfa(
  cfaModelSIS, 
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE,
  missing = "fiml",
  cluster = "clusterID",
  dataSIS
)

summary(pooledFitSIS, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)
```

```{r}
distrust <- paste0("MMQ_", c("13", "19", "20", "29"))
```

## ATE

```{r}

modelAte <- '

playerSmilePre  ~ experimental
playerSmilePost ~ experimental

playerSmilePre ~~ playerSmilePost

'

ateFit <- sem(
  model=modelAte,
  estimator="MLR",
  meanstructure=TRUE,
  data=dataAvatar
)

summary(ateFit)
```

### Descriptives

```{r}

plotData <- dataAvatar %>%
  mutate(
    experimental=as.factor(experimental)
  )

plotDataLong <- dataAvatarLong %>%
  mutate(
    experimental=as.factor(experimental)
  )

ggplot(data=plotData, aes(x=experimental, y=playerSmilePre, fill=experimental)) +
```

## Time

### Descriptives

```{r}

plotData <- dataAvatar %>%
  mutate(
    experimental = as.factor(experimental)
  )

ggplot(plotData, aes(x=roundTime, group=experimental, fill=experimental))+
  geom_histogram(bins=60)+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "lightcoral", "1" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "lightcoral", "1" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~experimental, labeller = labeller(experimental = c(
    "0" = "Control",
    "1" = "Treatment"
  ))) +  
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of time to agreement",
    x = "Time to agreement",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Exogenous model

```{r}

timeOne <- coxph(
  Surv(startTime, endTime, agreement) ~ experimental*playerSmilePre + avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound + cluster(clusterID),
  data = dataAvatarLong,
  ties = "efron"
)

summary(timeOne)
```

### Treatment heterogeneity

#### First stage

```{r}

test <- feols(
  logSyncShapeEMA_HL2s ~ experimental*playerEMA_HL2s + experimental*playerEMA_HL2s^2 + avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound | 0,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatarLong
)

summary(test)

test2 <- feols(
  syncShapePreDTW ~ experimental*playerSmilePre + experimental*playerSmilePre^2 + conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound | 0,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatar
)

summary(test2)

dataAvatarLong$fittedATE <- predict(test, newdata=dataAvatarLong)
```

#### Second stage

```{r}

timeSeven <- coxph(
  Surv(roundTime, agreement) ~ totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound + cluster(clusterID) + strata(clusterID),
  data = dataFS,
  ties = "efron"
)

summary(timeSeven)
```

## Test identification

```{r}

idVariables <- c(
  "clusterID"
)

analysisVariables <- c(
  "SIS_C1",
  "roundTime10s",
  "avatarDemand",
  "conflictHigh",
  "avatarDemand_conflictHigh",
  "secondRound",
  "timeToEquilibrium",
  "totalConcessions"
)

modelVariables <- c(analysisVariables, idVariables)

demeanedData <- dataAvatar %>%
  mutate(
    avatarDemand_conflictHigh = avatarDemand*conflictHigh,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    if_all(all_of(modelVariables), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  group_by(clusterID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n() == 2) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(analysisVariables) & where(is.numeric),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### SUR

```{r}

modelName <- "SUR"

modelSUR <- '
  
  SIS_C1 ~ 0*1 + secondRound + avatarDemand + conflictHigh + avatarDemand_conflictHigh + timeToEquilibrium + totalConcessions
  
  roundTime10s ~ 0*1 + secondRound + avatarDemand + conflictHigh + avatarDemand_conflictHigh + timeToEquilibrium + totalConcessions
  
  SIS_C1 ~~ roundTime10s

'

fitSUR <- sem(
  model = modelSUR,
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  data = demeanedData
)

parameterEstimates(fitSUR) %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, est, se, z, pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(op=="~1")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(est, se, z, pvalue), \(x) round(x, digits = 4))
  )
```

### Triangular system

```{r}

modelName <- "Triangular"

modelTriangular <- '
  
  SIS_C1 ~ roundTime10s + secondRound + avatarDemand + conflictHigh + avatarDemand:conflictHigh + realizedConcessions
  
  roundTime10s ~ secondRound + avatarDemand + conflictHigh + avatarDemand:conflictHigh + realizedConcessions + timeToEquilibrium
  
  SIS_C1 ~~ roundTime10s

'

fitTriangular <- sem(
  model = modelTriangular,
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  data = dataAvatar
)

parameterEstimates(fitTriangular) %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, est, se, z, pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(op=="~1")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(est, se, z, pvalue), \(x) round(x, digits = 4))
  )
```

```{r}

conflict2SLS <- ivreg2(
  roundTime10s ~ 0 + secondRound + avatarDemand + conflictHigh + avatarDemand_conflictHigh + timeToEquilibrium| SIS_C1 | totalConcessions,
  data = demeanedData,
  method = "2sls",
  clusters = ~clusterID,
  small = TRUE,
  dofminus = n_distinct(demeanedData$clusterID),
  endog = "SIS_C1",
  first_stage = TRUE
)

summary(conflict2SLS)
```

```{r}

conflictOne <- feols(
  SIS_C1 ~ playerSmilePre*experimental + roundTime + secondRound + conflictHigh | clusterID,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatar
)

summary(conflictOne)
```

### Control function

#### Risk set fun

```{r}

riskSetFun <- function(coxFit, data) {
  
  detail <- survival::coxph.detail(
    coxFit,
    riskmat = TRUE,
    rorder = "data"
  )
  
  # List of row indices belonging to each risk set
  riskRows <- lapply(
    seq_len(ncol(detail$riskmat)),
    function(j) which(detail$riskmat[, j] == 1)
  )
  
  usedRows <- match(rownames(detail$y), rownames(data))
  
  riskRowsOriginal <- lapply(
    riskRows,
    function(i) usedRows[i]
  )
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      riskRowsOriginal,
      function(indices) data[indices, , drop = FALSE]
    ),
    .id = "riskSet"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      riskSet = as.integer(riskSet),
      eventTime = detail$time[riskSet]
    )
}

dataAvatarBetween <- riskSetFun(coxControl, dataAvatarLong)
```

#### First stage

```{r}

firstStage <- feols(
  SIS_C1 ~ avatarDemand*conflictHigh + avatarDemand*endTime + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound | 0,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatarBetween
)

summary(firstStage)

firstStage <- feols(
  SIS_C1 ~ roundTime10s + avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound | 0,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatarBetween
)

summary(firstStage)

firstStage <- feols(
  SIS_C1 ~ avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + secondRound | 0 | roundTime10s ~ timeToEquilibrium,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatarBetween
)

summary(firstStage)
```

#### Second stage

```{r}

coxControl <- coxph(
  Surv(startTime, endTime, agreement) ~ SIS_C1 + avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound + cluster(clusterID) + strata(clusterID),
  data = dataAvatarLong,
  ties = "efron",
  tt = function(x, t, ...) {
    x * logp1(t)
  }
)

summary(coxControl)

linearControl <- feols(
  roundTime10s ~ SIS_C1 + avatarDemand*conflictHigh + totalConcessions + timeToEquilibrium + secondRound | clusterID,  cluster = "clusterID",
  data = dataAvatar
)

summary(linearControl)
```
